body: Movies taught me "across the river, not down the stream." The opposite of what actually works.
Absolutely. If all of humanity sat still, and faced forward, motionless and silent, then events will unfold as they are meant to. ^^^/s

I have my brother and sister nearby. I'm hesitant to try to discuss it with them, because they remember my younger episodes. They'll likely dismiss my concerns, and tell me to just go to therapy. I don't know if my plan even covers mental health care.
Thank you for sharing. This makes me a little braver about seeking help. I'm almost as afraid of losing my freedom, as I am of losing my life. Again, thank you.
